ios.desc:
Welcome to Scribble AI, the automatic text generator powered by OpenAI's GPT-3 Language Model. With Scribble AI, you can easily create a wide range of content in a matter of seconds.

To get started, simply:
 
1) Select the type of content you want to create (such as a LinkedIn post or poem)
2) Describe the topic you want to write about (e.g. "My new job at Google" or "My love for sailboats")
3) Set a word count (optional)
4) Choose a style, such as professional, flirty, funny, etc (optional)
5) Then hit "create" and let Scribble AI do the rest. If you're not satisfied with the output, simply hit "re-create" to generate a new version.

Here are some ideas for content you can create with Scribble AI:

• A comical retelling of the Trojan War in a satirical style
• A love letter to your favorite food in a romantic style
• An apology to your boss for being late to work in an apologetic style
• A LinkedIn post explaining why every business should invest in sustainable practices in a persuasive style
• A birthday message for your best friend in a funny style
• A love letter explaining why you love someone more than words can say in a romantic style
• A science article about the role of technology in modern education in an informative style

And the list continues! 

With Scribble AI, the possibilities are endless. Give it a try and see what creative content you can come up with!
